fact: On 1 November 2026 the DGDN launched a new version of the Fadaeldjazair geoportal, in service since March 2024, on a unified central database holding over 27 million documents from 217 land conservations, through which users can request land booklets, negative certificates, copies of published deeds and cadastral extracts online, pay online and track requests.
title: Fadaeldjazair : livret foncier, cadastre et actes, ce que change la nouvelle version du portail
